posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
There are a lot of errors in the code

You are not expected to echo anything on the terminal. You are just expected to run a command test. You are using echo that’s why you get multiple lines in the output.

  • One due to echo
  • Second from the errorlog which is printed by pressing submit button.
    image1470×529 107 KB

The actual output is automatically produced when the errorlog file is printed (by default action when pressed submit/test run button)

if block is not required.

What you are supposed to do?

Write only what’s asked execute the test command without using any echo one after the another. That’s it.

Solution:

test 2> errorlog
test -e 2>> errorlog
test -n 2>> errorlog

Also, I don’t know why you used an OCR scanner for copy pasting your code it messed up the quotes and added extra stuff making the code erroneous, which I fixed.

One tip - Whenever having issues with code, paste question no with week, your code using backticks and the test case screenshot for faster resolution.
```bash
Your code here
```

Thanks & Regards,
Swati Jain
